def install_package_command(package_name):
    '''install python package from pip'''
    import sys
    from subprocess import call
    cmds = 'python -m pip install --user {0}'.format(package_name) if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'python3 -m pip install --user {0}'.format(package_name)
    call(cmds, shell=True)
